Name: Better Mail Archive
Author: MadeInHeavenRequiem
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Mail Archive keeps a permanent, searchable record of every letter delivered to your farm. Once dismissed, vanilla letters cannot be reopened, making it easy to forget recipe hints, festival reminders, or notes sent by villagers.
This mod logs mail automatically as it arrives, recording the exact date of receipt and preserving the full text. Letters received prior to installing the mod are also included from your save file (marked as undated). Re-reading mail is completely safe: letters open in read-only mode, so attached gifts, quest flags, and cutscene triggers will not re-trigger or duplicate items.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Browse all received mail with titles, preview snippets, arrival dates, and sender portraits.[/color][/*]
[*]Instantly filter letters by typing keywords from the title, sender name, or letter body[/*]
[*]Compatible with custom NPCs, modded mail, and mail delivered via events or cutscenes. Letter text is cached within your save data, ensuring archived mail remains readable even if the mod that added it is removed later. [/*]
[/list]Press [b]L[/b] (default) in-game or while browsing the pause/inventory menu to open the archive. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (version 1.6 or newer)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0.0 or newer)[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] to edit settings directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Mail Archive
Manifest.Description: Keeps every letter you receive in a searchable archive, organised by the date it arrived. Press a key to re-read any letter, browse by month on an in-game calendar, or search the text of mail you got weeks ago.
